title: From first call *to signed agreement*
sub: A clear five-step process takes every project from the first call to a signed agreement, typically within 7–10 days.

steps.title: Discussion
steps.text: Initial call to understand concept, references, scope and quality target.

steps.title: Rate Card & Sample
steps.text: We share the rate card and sample production files for review.

steps.title: Client Scope & Files
steps.text: You share the full task scope, references and technical files.

steps.title: Tier & Engagement
steps.text: Tier and engagement model selected using historical benchmarks.

steps.title: Agreement & NDA
steps.text: Agreement and NDA signed: rate × estimated production effort.

models.title: Fixed Scope
models.text: Defined deliverables at an agreed price, billed against milestone approvals.

models.title: Time & Materials
models.text: Approved hours × rate, within an agreed range, for scope that's still evolving.

models.title: Artist Pod
models.text: A dedicated team billed monthly, best for volume, ongoing work or DLCs.

models.title: Data-driven
models.text: Production time is logged across every task, so estimates stay defensible and transparent.

ctaTitle: Ready to talk about your project?
ctaText: Send us your brief and we'll walk you through the process from here.
